intuition: Use a fixed-size array with a front index and item count; modular arithmetic wraps both ends.

brute_force.approach: Shift every remaining item after each dequeue to keep the front at index zero.
brute_force.time: enQueue O(1), deQueue O(k), Front O(1), Rear O(1)

optimal.approach: Keep the front and size, and calculate the rear index modulo the capacity.
optimal.time: enQueue O(1), deQueue O(1), Front O(1), Rear O(1), isEmpty O(1), isFull O(1)

edge_cases: An empty queue reports -1 at both ends.
A full queue rejects insertion until an item is removed.
